note: Frames of the two practice games. hand/lands/cast are card ids (repeats allowed). used = lands tapped this step, new = card that just appeared, stuck = cards that cannot be cast. Both games open with the same hand.

frames.title: Opening hand
frames.say: Archibaldus goes first. We show only the cards that matter.

frames.title: Turn 1
frames.say: He uses it for one fire mana and casts Lightning Bolt.

frames.title: Turn 2
frames.say: He draws an Island and plays it.

frames.title: Turn 2
frames.say: Water and fire: he summons the Goblin Electromancer.

frames.title: Turn 3
frames.say: He draws a Swamp and plays it.

frames.title: Turn 3
frames.say: Water, dark and fire: Crosis’s Charm. Three turns, three spells.

frames.title: Turn 1
frames.say: Mountain, then Lightning Bolt. So far, so good.

frames.title: Turn 2
frames.say: He draws a Swamp. The Electromancer needs water mana, and he has fire and dark.

frames.title: Turn 4
frames.say: A third Swamp. Four lands in play, and nothing cast since the first turn.
